description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for Android's reverb audio effect, including reverb presets, parameters, and processing functions.

classes.name: allpass_object_t
classes.description: Structure representing parameters for an allpass filter used in reverb processing.

classes.name: early_reflection_object_t
classes.description: Structure representing parameters for early reflections in reverb.

classes.name: reverb_preset_t
classes.description: Structure defining a reverb preset with various parameters.

classes.name: reverb_preset_bank_t
classes.description: Structure holding a bank of reverb presets.

classes.name: reverb_object_t
classes.description: Main structure representing the reverb effect's internal state and parameters.

classes.name: reverb_module_s
classes.description: Structure representing the reverb effect module, including interface and context.

methods.name: Reverb_UpdateXfade
methods.description: Updates crossfade parameters during reverb processing.

methods.name: ReverbCalculateNoise
methods.description: Generates a limited random noise sample for reverb processing.

methods.name: ReverbCalculateSinCos
methods.description: Calculates sine and cosine values based on phase for modulation.

methods.name: Reverb
methods.description: Applies reverb effect to input audio buffers.

methods.name: ReverbReadInPresets
methods.description: Loads default reverb presets into the effect.

methods.name: ReverbUpdateRoom
methods.description: Updates reverb room parameters based on preset changes.

methods.name: ReverbComputeConstants
methods.description: Computes constants needed for reverb processing based on sampling rate.
